memory_bridge: Lay the three strokes across March: 三月 supplies formal On サン, while three dumplings placed on the strokes are counted 三つ for native Kun みっつ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 三月（さんがつ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Print 三月（さんがつ） across the three-line March calendar; the opening sound fixes On サン in “March.”

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 三つ（みっつ）is common, modern, and pedagogically useful.
readings.overlay: Place one dumpling on each of the three strokes and count 三つ（みっつ）; the complete native counter fixes Kun みっつ, “three.”
